style.description:
Additional style information for certain block kinds.  For example, CODE blocks may have the programming language
for pretty printing.

spans.description: The spans within the simple block.

blocks.description: The sub-blocks within the compound block.

section.description: The ID of block for deep-linking, used for headings (H1, H2, etc).

isTab.description:
If this heading was defined as a tab (leaders of `=` instead of `#`).

@see DocumentationTab

title:
A heading is defined by a line beginning with # marks and having a title. It turns into an HTML `h1`, `h2`, etc.
Every heading is assigned a "section number", which is a hierarchical number based on the depth and ordering of
the headings.
name: DocumentationHeading
